description: The file is a shell script that contains a series of test cases validating the behavior of 'safe.directory' checks in Git. It tests various configurations and conditions related to safe directory settings, including environment variables, global and local git configurations, handling of symlinks, glob patterns, and special values like '*' and '.' that influence directory safety validation.

methods.name: expect_rejected_dir
methods.description: Defines a test helper function that runs 'git status' expecting it to fail with a 'dubious ownership' error, used to verify directories are correctly rejected when unsafe.
